title: Mark
description: One UI change request made by pointing at a live app with mark-kit. Written by the page (mark-kit.js) and completed by a store (id, status, history, commit, shot_path). One JSON object per line in .marks/marks.jsonl.

id.description: Made by the page; a store keeps it (re-adding the same id is a no-op).

note.description: What should change, in the user's words. May be empty when type says enough (e.g. remove).

scope.description: Absent = this element only. all = every element matching `match`.

match.description: scope=all: tag.class selector the request applies to (state classes is-* dropped).

matched.description: scope=all: how many elements matched when it was marked.

link.description: type=link: the other element and how the two relate.

selector.description: Full CSS path (fallback when the locator no longer resolves).

text.description: Element text, whitespace collapsed. Never contains what was typed into a field.

styles.description: Non-default computed styles that usually matter.

url.description: Page URL without the query string.

errors.description: Console errors since the previous mark.

sketch.description: Boxes drawn on the screenshot (type=add), in screenshot pixels. Also burned into the image.

shot.description: In flight only: PNG data URL from the host's capture. A store writes it to shot_path and never keeps it in the line.

shot_path.description: Repo-relative screenshot, e.g. .marks/shots/<id>.png. Inputs were blacked out.

status.description: Set by the store. Marks are never deleted.

commit.description: HEAD of the marked app when it was stored.

fix_commit.description: The commit that fixed it, when a fixer reports one.

reason.description: status=declined: why the fixer turned it down.

history.description: Every status change, oldest first. A reopen's `note` says what is still wrong.

locator.description: Short stable locator. Resolve: querySelectorAll(sel) under anchor (or the document), keep matches whose text (first 40 chars) is the same, then take index nth if still ambiguous.

anchor.description: #id of the nearest ancestor with an id; empty = document.

sel.description: tag.class (state classes is-* dropped), or #id when the element has one.

nth.description: Index among text-filtered matches; only present when needed.
